items.title: HiFi-KPI: A Dataset for Hierarchical KPI Extraction from Earnings Filings

label_json.notes: The released dataset and lite set give teams a practical way to test financial KPI extraction, and the 0.440 structured-extraction F1 shows a clear gap for LLM deployments.

items.title: Do Sheaf Neural Networks Use Holonomy? A Measure--Intervene--Control Study

label_json.notes: This is a careful causal study of one mechanism in sheaf networks, but even its own controls do not show that holonomy drives the task result.

items.title: Enabling Memory-efficient Im2win Convolution with Multi-precision Support on GPU CUDA and Tensor Cores

label_json.notes: The CUDA and tensor-core implementation reports concrete speed and memory gains over cuDNN and cuBLAS, which is useful to engineers optimizing CNN inference.

items.title: VoxPrivacy: A Benchmark for Evaluating Interactional Privacy of Speech Language Models

label_json.notes: The benchmark exposes a real multi-user privacy failure in speech models, tests nine systems on synthetic and human speech, and includes training data for mitigation.

items.title: Deja Vu in Plots: Leveraging Cross-Session Evidence with Retrieval-Augmented LLMs for Live Streaming Risk Assessment

label_json.notes: The paper shows a deployable moderation pattern: use cross-session evidence and LLM supervision to train a lightweight real-time risk detector, with offline and online validation.

items.title: Gauge dependence and structured-output corruption in sign-branched repetition penalties: measurements across models, inference stacks, and alternative repetition controls

label_json.notes: A commonly used inference setting cut valid schema-conforming JSON from 97% to 23%, and the paper identifies a normalization-based fix available in current tooling.

items.title: Deep Learning CNN and Recurrence Analysis for Alpha Gamma EEG Biomarkers in Fragile X Syndrome

label_json.notes: The work targets a narrow clinical biomarker problem and claims improvement without reporting enough result detail in the abstract to judge readiness or practical value.

items.title: Cultural Awareness is Represented but Not Decoded: Tracing Mythological Knowledge across 18 Open-Source LLMs

label_json.notes: Across 18 open models, cultural knowledge is present internally but often lost at decoding, and prompt language changes the failure pattern—useful evidence for multilingual evaluation.

items.title: VeriTrace: Human-Like Temporal Exploration Completes Agentic Action Space

label_json.notes: Giving the agent control over signals, time windows, and iteration improved Verilog debugging to 100% Pass@1 on the stated benchmark, offering a concrete agent-tool design lesson.

items.title: LLMs Struggle to Measure What Distinguishes Students of Different Proficiency Levels: A Study of Item Discrimination in Reading Comprehension Assessment

label_json.notes: Forty-two models failed to reproduce human item discrimination reliably, warning education teams not to treat LLM-generated responses as substitutes for student psychometrics.

items.title: DishSeg24k: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Food Segmentation with Stochastic Expert Decoding

label_json.notes: The 24,096-image benchmark and released model target a genuine long-tail segmentation problem and provide measurable gains that computer-vision teams can reproduce.

items.title: Beyond Top-K: Replacing Black-Box Retrieval with Interpretable Agentic Operations

label_json.notes: For table-heavy financial and regulatory documents, the study measures why chunk-and-embed retrieval loses units and years, then tests a replayable search alternative with much higher accuracy.

items.title: Optimized Certainty Equivalent Risk Minimization Using Samples: Algorithms, Convergence Rates, and Applications

label_json.notes: The abstract is primarily a theoretical optimization treatment; its broad finance and ML applications do not translate into an immediate deployment or engineering decision.

items.title: Digital Fragmentation and Generative AI Use Across 103 Million Application Events

label_json.notes: The 103-million-event study connects generative-AI use with a more focused period of application activity, giving workplace leaders evidence about AI and digital fragmentation.

items.title: 360CityArena: A Realistic Virtual Urban Navigation Benchmark for Embodied Agents

label_json.notes: The benchmark reveals a large human-to-model gap in realistic city navigation and supplies 175 human-built tasks for evaluating embodied agents.

items.title: Is CLIP Cross-Eyed? Revealing and Mitigating Center Bias in the CLIP Family

label_json.notes: The paper identifies an off-centre object failure in CLIP and offers training-free mitigations through visual prompting and attention redistribution.

items.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So

label_json.notes: The findings are about internal representation geometry in a small transformer, with no clear evaluation, product, or deployment change for a general newsletter reader.

items.title: Distillation of Foundation Models for Time-dependent PDEs

label_json.notes: The distillation method makes PDE foundation models several orders smaller and more than ten times faster while matching or beating the teacher on the tested benchmarks.

items.title: Unaccountable Delegation, Fading Skills: Mapping the Risks of Workplace AI Agents

label_json.notes: The worker-validated taxonomy turns 2,078 job tasks into concrete agent-risk scenarios and separates risks created by automation from those created by augmentation.

items.title: Detector-Augmented SAMURAI for Long-Duration Drone Tracking

label_json.notes: The detector-augmented tracker materially improves long-duration drone tracking, especially after exit and re-entry, with substantial success-rate and false-negative gains.

items.title: DSPrompt: Dynamic Soft Prompt Defense Against M-RAG Corruption

label_json.notes: The defense reduces multimodal RAG poisoning while adding under 1% parameters and no per-query optimization, making the security trade-off relevant to deployed retrieval systems.

items.title: Solving nonconvex Hamilton--Jacobi--Isaacs equations with PINN-based policy iteration

label_json.notes: This is a specialized numerical method for Hamilton–Jacobi–Isaacs equations; the abstract does not give a broadly reusable AI engineering or organizational lesson.

items.title: Bridging Lexical Divergence: LLM-Assisted, Cost-Efficient, Zero-shot Scientific Entity Linking

label_json.notes: Selective alias generation and ontology filtering reduce LLM cost and noise for scientific entity linking, with results across five benchmarks and released evaluation data.

items.title: Advantage Weighted Matching: Aligning RL with Pretraining in Diffusion Models

label_json.notes: The method aligns diffusion RL with the pretraining objective and reports up to 34× faster optimization without reducing generation quality.

items.title: Separating Syntax from Language: A Mechanistic Account of Translation in Multilingual LLMs

label_json.notes: The causal analysis of syntax and surface language is interesting model science, but the abstract does not lead to a concrete deployment or engineering action.

items.title: PopPert: Population-level Joint-Distribution Modeling for Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction

label_json.notes: The method is valuable for single-cell perturbation research, but it is too domain-specific and gives no deployment or product implication beyond benchmark performance.

items.title: Citing Less Critically: LLMs Reshape the Rhetoric and Reach of Scientific Citation

label_json.notes: Across more than 63,000 citation contexts, LLM-assisted writing was less critical and favored popular, older work, a useful governance warning for scientific publishing workflows.

items.title: Public-Sharing Labels and Verbatim Field Egress in an MCP-to-A2A Agent Configuration: A Controlled Multi-Model Study

label_json.notes: The controlled 480-trial study shows that a PUBLIC label can increase verbatim data egress in an MCP-to-A2A workflow, with strong model dependence that deployment teams should test.

items.title: RoGe: Novel View Synthesis via End-to-End Implicit Reconstruction and Generation

label_json.notes: The end-to-end design removes the lossy explicit 3D bridge and improves sparse-view video synthesis and temporal consistency over reconstruction and generation baselines.

items.title: A Mathematical Theory of Reusable Neural Bases for Network Compression

label_json.notes: The compression idea is potentially useful, but the abstract gives no concrete model sizes, compression ratios, memory savings, or benchmark numbers to support a newsletter claim.
